crusadecraft.zone.adopted: Your Throne stands in the zone of %s: this drawn realm is now yours, with its lands and cities.
crusadecraft.chronicle.adopted: The realm takes over the lands and cities of %s.
crusadecraft.zone.merge.same: A realm cannot merge with itself.
crusadecraft.zone.merge.tip: Pick the realm that absorbs this one (click, or Shift+click to go back), then OK twice: its cities, painted lands and treasury pass to the other.
crusadecraft.codex.zones.p0: In the map editor, create a realm and paint its zone before anyone lives there. Then place your $(l)Throne$() in that zone: the drawn realm becomes $(l)yours$(), with its painted lands and its cities.$(br2)A new colony you found inside your realm's zone (painted or claimed) $(l)joins it on its own$().
crusadecraft.codex.zones.p1: $(l)Merge$(): in the editor, pick a city of a computer realm, then "Merge into" and OK twice. Its cities, painted lands and treasury pass to the chosen realm, computer or player.
